flashcard_questions.q: The practices and procedures that ensure food is handled, prepared, stored, and cooked safely to prevent contamination and foodborne illness.
The thorough cleaning of hands with hot water and soap to remove bacteria and prevent the transfer of micro-organisms to food.
A bright blue waterproof dressing used in food preparation areas because it is easy to spot if it falls into food and does not match any natural food colour.

flashcard_questions.a: The guideline that anyone who has had vomiting or diarrhoea must wait at least 48 hours after symptoms stop before handling food, to avoid spreading infection.
The transfer of harmful bacteria or other contaminants from one food (usually raw) to another (usually ready-to-eat), typically via hands, utensils, or surfaces.
